proof:
by
  intro total
  have hclaim := total { collateral := fun _ => 10, debt := fun _ => 0, pool := 10 } 1 0 5 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  exact absurd hclaim (by decide)
reasoning: Over arbitrary states the pool can back honest claims only under a reachability invariant. Concrete counterexample: pool 10, borrower collateral 10, honest collateral 10, no debt; borrower withdraws 5 (guard passes since 0 ≤ (10-5)/2), leaving pool 5 below the honest claim 10. The target is invalid as stated over arbitrary states; a sound version needs a reachability invariant.
